# Rumble script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (`cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## rumble.sendMessage

Sends a message in your Rumble chat. Only works while you are live on Rumble and signed in; otherwise it fails. Empty text is skipped.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `message` | What to say, like "Welcome to the stream!" |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("rumble.sendMessage", new { message = "Welcome to the stream!" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("rumble.sendMessage", message="Welcome to the stream!")
    ```
